dining.name: Cafe Stella
dining.notes: Reopened after 2024 closure; slimmed menu — steak au poivre, frisée, frozen-lemon sorbet. Sunset Junction, home turf.

dining.name: Rasarumah
dining.notes: Eastside hotspot (Variety also flagged it). Confirm exact address/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Dunsmoor
dining.notes: Restored 1920s building around a huge wood-burning hearth. Eastside, on-profile for a special night.

dining.name: Yess
dining.notes: Grew out of the Yess Aquatic seafood truck. Chef Junya Yamasaki — confirm details next pass.

dining.name: Sushi Nakazawa
dining.notes: Omakase from a Jiro Ono protégé; NYC import's LA debut. Neighborhood unconfirmed.

dining.name: Hermon's
dining.notes: Refreshed chophouse from the Found Oyster team — martinis, pull-apart garlic bread, pasta vongole. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Mish
dining.notes: New-wave deli on La Brea — wood-fired bagels, shakshuka with challah, pastrami reuben on schmaltz-griddled rye.

dining.name: Asadero
dining.notes: Above-average taco stand — smoky asada from a chef who left corporate kitchens. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Amiguita
dining.notes: On the Resy Hit List; details unconfirmed — fill in cuisine/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Pasjoli
dining.notes: Refined French bistro, Chef Dave Beran (ex-Alinea). Westside — special-occasion, not walkable.

dining.name: Kassi
dining.notes: Greek-Med rooftop in Venice — mezze, lamb chops, grilled whole fish. Westside.

dining.name: San Laurel
dining.notes: Spanish-inflected dining high in the InterContinental DTLA (José Andrés group).

dining.name: Calabra
dining.notes: Mediterranean rooftop atop the Santa Monica Proper — charred flatbreads, mezze, grilled fish.

dining.name: Found Oyster
dining.notes: Tiny, buzzy seafood bar — clam cakes, chicken-fried oysters. Walk-in/bar; parent of Hermon's. Home turf.

dining.name: Bar Restaurant
dining.notes: Pink-hued, 'strange and fantastic' modern French. Intimate date-night; books up. Sunset Junction, walkable.

dining.name: Sogo Roll Bar
dining.notes: Handroll bar from the Sushi Note team — creative, high-quality fish. Counter seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Lolo Wine Bar
dining.notes: Low-key neighborhood wine bar with a great patio + shareable pasta. Walkable from home.

dining.name: Marco Polo
dining.notes: Outdoor-focused Italian — linguini vongole, gin-arugula cocktails. Patio date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Clark Street Bakery
dining.notes: Echo Park bakery — caramelized kouign-amann, Nordic breakfast platters. Daytime/casual.

dining.name: Kismet Rotisserie
dining.notes: Casual rotisserie next to Kismet — roast chicken on pita, veg sides. Easy weeknight. Eastside.

dining.name: Jeff's Table
dining.notes: Cult deli hidden behind a liquor store — pastrami, specialty turkey. Lunch. Eastside.

dining.name: Yang's Kitchen
dining.notes: Order-at-counter Taiwanese-Chinese — braised pork rice, beef scallion wraps. SGV-adjacent.

dining.name: Sonmari
dining.notes: Silver Lake handroll spot — inventive DIY rolls (gochujang eel, 'banh mi' albacore). Walkable.

dining.name: Bar Di Bello
dining.notes: Low-lit Milanese-style aperitivo bar — cutlets, branzino, antipasti. Date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Holbox
dining.notes: Game-changing Mexican seafood stall in Mercado La Paloma — aguachiles, tostadas. Michelin Bib-tier value (confirm). Walk-up.

dining.name: Quarter Sheets
dining.notes: Thick pan-style pizza + great wine list. Bib Gourmand value. Echo Park — walkable from home.

dining.name: Pizzeria Bianco
dining.notes: Chris Bianco's LA outpost (Row DTLA) — among the country's best pizza. Bib Gourmand. Confirm exact address.

dining.name: Sushi Note
dining.notes: Sushi-and-wine bar (team behind Sogo Roll Bar). Valley — a destination, not walkable.

dining.name: Santo
dining.notes: Japanese-Mexican nigiri/handrolls + sake & wine, Sunset Junction. Home turf; next to Bar Seco. (Santō)

dining.name: Bar Seco
dining.notes: Natural wine bar + small plates (CDMX/Madrid/Japan), spills onto Sunset. Walk-in/sidewalk seats. Next to Santo. (aka Seco)

dining.name: Superba
dining.notes: ARI'S ABSOLUTE FAVORITE — food + ambiance, the patio especially (also great inside). Superba Food + Bread, Lincoln Blvd. Westside — worth the drive.

dining.name: L&E Oyster Bar
dining.notes: Silver Lake oyster bar; the upstairs bar is the chill walk-in move. Home turf.

dining.name: Pijja Palace
dining.notes: Indian-Italian sports bar — pizza, pasta, cricket on the TVs. Very popular (hard rez / walk-in bar). Silver Lake, home turf.

dining.name: Night + Market Song
dining.notes: Kris Yenbamroong's fiery northern Thai on Sunset. Walk-in friendly. Home turf.

dining.name: Momed
dining.notes: Mediterranean — mezze, wraps, bowls. Atwater Village (also Beverly Hills). Eastside, easy.

dining.name: Bar Siesta
dining.notes: New Spanish tapas + all-Spanish wine bar (Heather Sperling team). On-taste wine bar, home turf.

dining.name: Atrium
dining.notes: Playful, vaguely-French cooking from Douglas Rankin in the old Malo space, Sunset Junction. New. Home turf.

dining.name: Bowery Bungalow
dining.notes: Modern Mediterranean from George Abou-Daoud in the former Sompun Thai. New, home turf.

dining.name: Frank n Franks
dining.notes: Sandwich spot from a Howlin' Ray's vet. Casual lunch, Chinatown — eastside-adjacent.

high: live bands across the spectrum — garage / proto-punk / post-punk / indie / art-rock / experimental in intimate clubs (Zebulon, The Echo, Lodge Room, Teragram, Gold Diggers)
global / diaspora / traditional & roots music — desert blues, Latin alternative, cumbia, Afro-funk, highlife, Anatolian/psych, world & folk traditions (the ethnomusicologist core)
jazz, soul, funk & live-band nights in listening rooms and small clubs (ETA, Gold Line)
craft / songwriter pop with a point of view (Olivia Rodrigo, Mitski, Caroline Polachek tier)
medium: rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, New Beverly, Cinematheque, Aero, Alex Theatre)
record fairs, listening bars, vinyl nights, in-stores & album-listening events
cultural / heritage programming — museum nights, music-doc screenings, talks & performances
daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / record / design markets, farmers markets, street fairs
theater & performing arts (black-box through Pantages / Ahmanson scale)
low: DJ sets / electronic in a chill, musical, listening-forward setting (not the main thing)
big-room / festival EDM and warehouse techno — only a marquee, genuinely special name

boosts: vinyl / all-analog presentation, record-store & in-store shows
walkable or short drive from Sherman Oaks / the Valley (Studio City, NoHo, Burbank, Encino, Toluca Lake)
independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA, KCRW)
penalties: generic Top-40 / open-format club nights with no real billing
tribute / cover bands and "[decade] night" nostalgia nights
far-flung (OC / SD / Temecula / Ventura / Long Beach) unless genuinely worth the trip

artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

events.title: Countdown NYE 2026
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Seven Lions
artist_notes.note: Jeff Montalvo — melodic dubstep/bass pioneer and Ophelia Records founder; the genre-defining name pulling this bill outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: TOKiMONSTA
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jennifer Lee) — Grammy-nominated future-beat/bass artist and one of the first women to headline a Coachella mainstage set; genre-blending rather than straight house/techno.

artist_notes.name: Tchami
artist_notes.note: French DJ/producer who coined 'future house' and runs the Confession label/party brand — the more house-leaning name on an otherwise bass-heavy bill.

artist_notes.name: Oliver Heldens
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer — broke out with 2014's 'Gecko,' a future-house pioneer alongside Tchami; also runs a deeper techno alias, HI-LO.

artist_notes.name: Gordo
artist_notes.note: Formerly Carnage — the trap/EDM producer rebranded into house a few years back and now runs with the Solid Grooves crowd; a genuine lane-shift, not just a rename.

artist_notes.name: Flosstradamus
artist_notes.note: Chicago duo (Curt Cameruci, Josh Young) — one of the acts that built festival trap in the early 2010s, still a heavy bass-stage draw.

artist_notes.name: Mija
artist_notes.note: LA bass/house DJ-producer in the Brownies & Lemonade orbit — eclectic, genre-hopping sets that land more bass-forward than house.

artist_notes.name: R3hab
artist_notes.note: Dutch big-room/progressive house DJ-producer (Cyb3rpvnk) — festival-mainstage staple for over a decade.

artist_notes.name: Archie Hamilton
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/label owner — an early architect of a rugged, atmospheric minimal-house-and-techno sound; MicroHertz label boss and a Paradise Ibiza regular.

artist_notes.name: James Hype
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house/bass-house DJ-producer — viral 'Ferrari' remix and a PIRATE Copenhagen resident; crossed from underground tech-house into a full mainstage festival draw.

artist_notes.name: Ranger Trucco
artist_notes.note: Michigan-born tech-house producer/vocalist, Space Yacht signee — clean, warbling tech-house with his own sung hooks.

artist_notes.name: TOBEHONEST
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house DJ/producer on the come-up — Latin-groove/hip-hop-inflected sound with Beatport Top 100 releases and cosigns from Chris Lake and John Summit.

artist_notes.name: TroyBoi
artist_notes.note: UK bass/trap producer known for a distinctive chopped-vocal sound — a big mainstage draw in the bass-music world, outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Walker & Royce
artist_notes.note: LA house/tech-house duo — Dirtybird-adjacent, quirky vocal-driven house cuts; a home-turf name on this bill.

enrichment.curator_note: Insomniac's flagship NYE blowout at NOS — DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello are real headliners, and there's a genuine house/tech-house thread running through Gordo, Walker & Royce and TOBEHONEST, but most of this 30-deep bill is bass/trap/dubstep mainstage stuff, not a selector's set. Go for the production and the countdown, not the DJing.
enrichment.description: Insomniac's Countdown NYE 2026 at NOS Event Center — a 30-plus-artist multi-stage lineup headlined by DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello, running house through bass/trap into midnight.

events.title: Category Vol. 004: Decadence Nye - Chris Cruse, Heidi Lawden b2b Masha Mar, Juliet Mendoza, Still Rollin, Soul Purpose, Nate
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Chris Cruse
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse DJ since 2001 and founder of Spotlight, now Berlin-based; plays Panorama Bar; tough, soulful sound.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector with 90s UK rave roots; marathon house/techno/disco sets.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/curator from the Midnight Lovers crew; Italo, disco and house.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ and dancer, founder of Jill's House, Defected Unsung Heroes alum.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Dj Kerry
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since 2005, longtime Dublab radio host and founder of The Basement, a membership-based party rooted in Paradise Garage/West Coast warehouse tradition.

artist_notes.name: Soul Purpose (LA)
artist_notes.note: LA underground/festival selector (Splash House, Lightning in a Bottle, EDC) blending disco, 90s house, minimal, techno and hard groove — a dancefloor generalist more than a specialist.

enrichment.curator_note: A stacked, DJ-first New Year's Eve at the Belasco, with Chris Cruse back from Berlin and the LA house heavyweights behind him. Ticket range is wide, so watch the tier you land on.
enrichment.description: Category Vol. 004 Decadence NYE at the Belasco Theater, a multi-DJ house and techno New Year's party.

artist_notes.name: Polo & Pan
artist_notes.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille and Alexandre Grynszpan) making lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and house with Balearic and disco touches.

events.title: Jersey Boys
events.detail: They were just four guys from Jersey, until they sang their very first note. They had a sound nobody had ever heard... and the radio just couldn’t get enough of. But while their harmonies were perfect on stage, off stage it was a very different story -- a story that has made them an international sensation all over again. The show features all their hits including “Sherry,” “Big Girls Don’t Cry,” “Oh What a Night,” “Walk Like a Man,” “Can’t Take My Eyes Off You,” “Beggin’” and “Working My Way Back to You.”Go behind the music and inside the story of Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons in the Tony Award®-winning, original Broadway sensation, JERSEY BOYS.  From the streets of New Jersey to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, this is the musical that’s too good to be true.

profile.taste_yaml:
# Taste profile — Sevag (dashboard profile-switcher, username: sevag).
#
# Sevag is early 30s, lives in Sherman Oaks (the Valley), and is married to Alexa (username:
# alexa). Seeded 2026-10-11 as a straight copy of Lori's taste (profiles/lori/taste.yaml):
# band / live-music-forward, broad ear — proto-punk / garage / post-punk through craft pop, plus
# global / diaspora / jazz / soul. Only the geo bits were retuned for Sherman Oaks. Diverges from
# Lori's from here on. Mechanism (geo + weights) lives in profiles/sevag/profile.yaml.
# Edit this, then: python scripts/build_profiles.py --only sevag

categories:
  high:
    # +3
    - live bands across the spectrum — garage / proto-punk / post-punk / indie /
      art-rock / experimental in intimate clubs (Zebulon, The Echo, Lodge Room,
      Teragram, Gold Diggers)
    - global / diaspora / traditional & roots music — desert blues, Latin
      alternative, cumbia, Afro-funk, highlife, Anatolian/psych, world & folk
      traditions (the ethnomusicologist core)
    - jazz, soul, funk & live-band nights in listening rooms and small clubs
      (ETA, Gold Line)
    - craft / songwriter pop with a point of view (Olivia Rodrigo, Mitski,
      Caroline Polachek tier)
    - classic rock
    - goth
    - alternative
    - indie
    - grunge
    - punk
  medium:
    # +2
    - rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, New Beverly, Cinematheque, Aero,
      Alex Theatre)
    - record fairs, listening bars, vinyl nights, in-stores & album-listening
      events
    - cultural / heritage programming — museum nights, music-doc screenings,
      talks & performances
    - daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / record / design markets, farmers
      markets, street fairs
    - theater & performing arts (black-box through Pantages / Ahmanson scale)
  low:
    # +1, only if exceptional
    - DJ sets / electronic in a chill, musical, listening-forward setting (not
      the main thing)
    - big-room / festival EDM and warehouse techno — only a marquee, genuinely
      special name

boosts:
  # +1 each (stack)
  - intimate / seated / listening-room setting
  - vinyl / all-analog presentation, record-store & in-store shows
  - walkable or short drive from Sherman Oaks / the Valley (Studio City, NoHo,
    Burbank, Encino, Toluca Lake)
  - Friday or Saturday night
  - independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA, KCRW)
  - outdoor / garden / sunset setting

penalties:
  # -2 each
  - bottle-service / table-service nightclubs
  - generic Top-40 / open-format club nights with no real billing
  - tribute / cover bands and "[decade] night" nostalgia nights
  - far-flung (OC / SD / Temecula / Ventura / Long Beach) unless genuinely worth
    the trip

# Match in a lineup => +2 and a "tracked" badge. Copied from Lori's list — proto-punk & garage,
# indie / art-rock, craft pop, and the global / diaspora / jazz spine.
artists_tracked:
  # proto-punk / garage / punk (the Stooges end)
  - Iggy Pop
  - The Stooges
  - Osees
  - Ty Segall
  - King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
  - Parquet Courts
  - Viagra Boys
  - Fontaines D.C.
  - Idles
  # indie / art-rock / post-punk
  - black midi
  - Black Country, New Road
  - Big Thief
  - Cate Le Bon
  - Weyes Blood
  - Angel Olsen
  - Sharon Van Etten
  - Dry Cleaning
  # craft / songwriter pop (the Olivia Rodrigo end)
  - Olivia Rodrigo
  - Mitski
  - Caroline Polachek
  - Japanese Breakfast
  - Faye Webster
  - boygenius
  - Alanis Morissette # 90s confessional alt-rock — the ancestor of the craft-pop lane; arena tours
  # global / diaspora / Latin alt / desert blues (the ethnomusicologist spine)
  - Chicano Batman
  - Hermanos Gutiérrez
  - Khruangbin
  - Mdou Moctar
  - Tinariwen
  - Bombino
  - Altın Gün
  - Combo Chimbita
  - Meridian Brothers
  - Helado Negro
  - Y La Bamba
  - Hurray for the Riff Raff
  # jazz / soul / funk (LA scene)
  - Kamasi Washington
  - Thundercat
  - BadBadNotGood
  - Adrian Younge
  - Kacey Musgraves
  - Grateful Dead
  - David Bowie
  - Lauryn Hill

    forward, broad genre range; penalize only bottle-service clubs / cover

profile.profile_yaml:
# profile.yaml — MECHANISM config for Sevag's dashboard feed (username: sevag).
# Copied from Lori's (profiles/lori/profile.yaml) — same band/live-music weighting — with the
# geo retuned for Sherman Oaks (the Valley) instead of Glendale. taste.yaml = CONTENT; this = MECHANISM.

city: Los Angeles
timezone: America/Los_Angeles

# Home base — Sherman Oaks (drives the "close to home" boost + night-planner travel times).
home:
  neighborhood: Sherman Oaks
  coords: [34.1510, -118.4490]   # geo.py's Sherman Oaks centroid; used by scripts/lib/geo.py

sources:
  ticketmaster_dma_id: "324"   # LA DMA
  ra_area_id: 23               # RA's LA area number

scoring:
  # Band/live-music-forward. Live music is the top lane; electronic is welcome but secondary
  # (Lori's taste: "more into bands than electronic", not anti-electronic). Pop is a real lane
  # (Olivia Rodrigo); art bumped for the ethnomusicologist's cultural appetite.
  category_weights:
    music: 3          # live music (catalog's term) — the spine
    live_music: 3
    pop: 2            # craft pop (Olivia Rodrigo tier)
    film: 2           # rep & arthouse cinema
    theater: 2
    beer_food: 2
    art: 2            # cultural / heritage / museum programming
    electronic: 2     # secondary, not unwelcome — a good DJ/live-electronic act still counts
    party: 1          # club / warehouse / afterhours — not the scene
    comedy: 1
    general: 1

  rating_thresholds:
    - [8, 5]
    - [6, 4]
    - [4, 3]
    - [2, 2]

  # Walkable / short drive from Sherman Oaks (+1). Valley-centric radius, plus the over-the-hill
  # spots a short 101/405 hop away (Hollywood, WeHo, Brentwood/Westwood via the pass).
  near_home_neighborhoods:
    - sherman oaks
    - studio city
    - encino
    - van nuys
    - valley village
    - north hollywood
    - noho
    - noho arts district
    - toluca lake
    - burbank
    - universal city
    - tarzana
    - reseda
    - lake balboa
    - glendale
    - hollywood
    - west hollywood
    - weho
    - laurel canyon
    - bel air
    - brentwood
    - westwood

  # +1: setting boost retuned for a band-head — rewards intimate / analog / outdoor rooms,
  # NOT afterhours DJ parties. (Dropped "groove"/"disco"/"all night" etc., which were inflating
  # electronic afters — "groove" even substring-matched "Groovers Inn".)
  groove_terms:
    - vinyl
    - all-analog
    - all analog
    - listening
    - record store
    - in-store
    - rooftop
    - sunset
    - golden hour
    - open-air
    - open air
    - outdoor
    - garden
    - patio

  # European house-label boost is electronic-scene specific and largely irrelevant to her;
  # kept inert (a token that won't match) so the engine doesn't fall back to Ari's label list.
  eu_terms:
    - __no_eu_boost__

  # -2 each. Pared down from Ari's list: NO hip-hop / dubstep / hardstyle / EDM-genre penalties
  # (a diverse, knowledgeable music head — genre breadth is the point). Kept: the genuinely
  # off-taste stuff (bottle-service clubs, generic no-billing Top-40 nights, tribute/cover/decade
  # nostalgia) and the non-music junk.
  penalty_terms:
    - bottle service
    - bottle-service
    - vip table
    - table service
    - top 40
    - top-40
    - open format
    - open-format
    - tribute
    - cover band
    - watch party
    - world cup
    - fifa
    - sports bar
    - trivia
    - bingo
    - karaoke
    - networking
    - webinar
    - virtual
    - zoom

  # -2: far-flung from Sherman Oaks (not worth the trip by default).
  far_terms:
    - anaheim
    - santa ana
    - irvine
    - san diego
    - temecula
    - ventura
    - riverside
    - long beach
    - costa mesa
    - huntington beach

  # Spotify + feedback music layer (Phase C) — same mechanics as root; inert until Sevag has a
  # Spotify artifact / feedback log of his own. Enriches taste.yaml, never overwrites it.
  spotify:
    tier_points:
      core: 3
      strong: 2
      light: 1
      hidden: -3
    artist_cap: 5
    genre_points: 1
    genre_threshold: 0.5
    genre_cap: 1
    min_name_len: 3
    ambiguous_names: [train, future, juice, jungle, lights, justice, work, sanctuary, paradise,
                      chance, hold, alive]

  feedback:
    weights:
      loved: 2.0
      went: 1.5
      clicked_ticket: 0.5
      added_calendar: 0.5
      skipped: -0.5
      hide: -10.0

# Travel / geography for the night-planner (scripts/lib/geo.py) — same tunables as root.
geo:
  travel:
    walk_max_miles: 0.8
    walk_min_per_mile: 20.0
    drive_floor_min: 8
